skill_name: Summarize this passage in three sentences.
workflow: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix is the fifth installment in the Harry Potter book series, released in 2003. The book was the longest of the series, measuring over 700 pages, and follows the story of teenager Harry Potter's struggle against Lord Voldemort. Lord Voldemort is attempting to gain power over the wizarding world, and Harry must use his magic and courage to save the day.
